purpose: `GiftingService` stores virtual pass and developer-product entitlements under a player's `Gifted` PlayerDataStoreService root. It uses GameConfig keys, enforces configurable social restrictions, keeps server and client caches, serializes the client projection with Squash, and can fulfill paid gifts through `GameProductService`.
description: `GiftingService` stores virtual pass and developer-product entitlements under a player's `Gifted` PlayerDataStoreService root. It uses GameConfig keys, enforces configurable social restrictions, keeps server and client caches, serializes the client projection with Squash, and can fulfill paid gifts through `GameProductService`.

GiftingServiceClient.luau.description: Read-only local gift cache with map, per-gift, type-filtered, and Brio observation APIs. Public entry points include `GiftingServiceClient.Init`, `GiftingServiceClient.Start`, `GiftingServiceClient.ReadyAsync`, `GiftingServiceClient.GetGifts`, `GiftingServiceClient.GetGift`, `GiftingServiceClient.HasGift`, `GiftingServiceClient.HasEntitlementAsync`, `GiftingServiceClient.ObserveGifts`.

Shared/GiftingAssetTypes.luau.description: Asset categories that can be persisted as gifts.

Shared/GiftingDuplicateBehavior.luau.description: Controls how GiftAsync handles an existing gift with the same key.

Shared/GiftingNetwork.luau.description: Compact replication for the local player's gifts. Pending purchase intents and processed receipt IDs remain server-only.

Shared/GiftingRestrictions.luau.description: Controls who a player may gift.

Shared/GiftingSerializationUtils.luau.description: Squash serialization for compact gift snapshots. Static field names never enter the network payload. Public entry points include `GiftingSerializationUtils.serialize`, `GiftingSerializationUtils.deserialize`.
